summary: Frontend test of the Sales 'Nouvelle vente' reset fix (Sales.js resetSaleForm/handleSaleDialogChange). Closing with the X, Escape or a click outside the dialog now resets everything: cart empty, total 0 GNF, product search empty, customer empty, payment back to Espèces. Regression checks pass: add to cart, quantity 2 gives 4 000 GNF, 'Mettre en attente' works (toast shown, ATT-F4D), and 'Reprendre' loads the pending items (qty 2, 4 000 GNF); after closing, reopening gives an empty form. BUG: the dialog's 'Annuler' button calls setShowDialog(false) directly, so the reset never runs and the old cart, customer and search come back when the dialog reopens.

ui_bugs.component: Sales.js New sale dialog - Annuler button (~line 2701)
ui_bugs.issue: onClick={() => setShowDialog(false)} does not reset the form (Radix onOpenChange is not called when the controlled prop changes). Reproduced: add PARACETAMOL + customer 'TEST_client' + search 'para', click Annuler, reopen: cart_items=1, total=2 000 GNF, search='para', customer='TEST_client'.

integration_issues.issue: handleResumePendingSale cancels the pending sale on the backend right away. Now that closing the dialog clears the cart, a user who clicks Reprendre and then closes without validating loses the pending sale for good: it is gone from the server and from the cart. Before the fix the cart stayed in memory, so this data loss is new. Suggestion: only cancel or convert the pending sale when the sale is validated or put back on hold, or put it back on hold automatically when the dialog closes with a resumed cart.

action_items: Change the Annuler button in the New sale dialog to onClick={() => handleSaleDialogChange(false)}
Fix the loss of a resumed pending sale when the dialog is closed without validating (do not cancel on resume, or put it back on hold on close)
Optional: handlePutOnHold onSuccess and the post-submit success paths reset state by hand; call resetSaleForm() there to avoid leftover state (e.g. paymentMethod, productSearch after hold)
Add data-testid to the pending-sale Reprendre and Delete buttons (e.g. resume-pending-{id}, cancel-pending-{id})
critical_code_review_comments: Sales.js is 3645 lines; it should be split (sale dialog, pending sales dialog, return dialog)
Form resets are duplicated in handleSubmit online/offline, handlePutOnHold and resetSaleForm; keep only resetSaleForm
EMPTY_PAYMENT_DETAILS is defined inside the component; move it to module scope
seed_data_creation: One pending sale (ATT-F4D, PARACETAMOL x2) was created and then consumed or cancelled by 'Reprendre'. No final sale was validated.
